requirements.text: Implement real-time notifications for all account transactions, including key details such as transaction amount, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Introduce biometric authentication methods (fingerprint and facial recognition) for a seamless and secure login experience.
Develop in-app lending features with a straightforward application process, real-time application status updates, and a pre-approval feature.
Ensure compliance with Central Bank regulations regarding consumer protection and responsible lending, including assessing creditworthiness and repayment ability.
Maintain backwards compatibility by offering both the legacy and modernised apps for a transitional period of at least six months.
Ensure a consistent user experience across both platforms to avoid confusion when switching between apps.
Provide clear communication to customers about the changes, navigation assistance, and the transition timeline through in-app notifications, emails, and tutorials.
Gather user feedback during the transition to identify pain points and make necessary adjustments.
Ensure user-friendliness, especially for less tech-savvy customers during the biometric authentication setup process.
Comply with regulations regarding data security and privacy, ensuring that any biometric data is securely encrypted and stored.
